svg.aria-label: About Burak. I'm Burak, a second-year Computer Programming student in Türkiye. I build AI automation and agent tooling: an MCP-based skill and memory system, a local-first coding agent and exploratory LLM evaluation work. I develop with AI end to end, and I write down how each project works and how to run it. Alongside that, I work in data science. I'm open to internship and junior opportunities. Ai Automation & Agents: MCP, Tool-using agents, LLM evaluation, TypeScript, GitHub Actions. Data Science: Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter.
